# GE-154 — V0 integration decisions (Draft 0.3 supplement, approved for implementation only)

Inputs: GE-155 PR #8 @ 447f56270cee088fd2d26b1264ea612d68ccc3e9, GE-152 PR #5 @ ab0a53b, GE-151 PR #6 @ 9b56aab, draft 0.2 @ 7a5fe22. This answers FORMAT_QUESTIONS.md; supersedes conflicting prose in draft 0.2 for V0 only. No release, hardware approval or final freeze until cross-agent conformance.

## A. Registry
Accept the versioned object groove-slots/1: exact keys format, capacity, generation, slots; each slot exact keys index, coord, id. Initial capacity 2; 2..256 via explicit grow, never shrink silently. Indexes contiguous ordered, unique IDs, fixed coordinates index 0 [0,9,0] and 1 [0,9,1]; indices >=2 require both coord:null AND id:null until a future verified mapping contract. Coordinates must be arrays of exactly three integers (not bool/float), IDs obey the runtime manifest ID rules including exact fullmatch, DOS device rejection. 64 KiB maximum on disk, bounded read, strict UTF-8/JSON, duplicate keys rejected, bounded nesting. generation integer 0..2147483647, increase exactly once per effective registry transaction, never wrap; reject overflow, no-op is unchanged. No silent migration/reset of harness list. Installer sole writer. Runtime validates complete registry and referenced package, takes immutable session snapshot (ID, version, files); invalid/unmapped slots fail closed. No live SD modifications while game runs; installer/recovery must be offline. If installer lock/journal exists, loader blocks custom launches until recovery; do not touch native progress. Generation is for registry changes, not trust or content authentication.

## B. Engine marker
Accept groove-engine/1 with exact fields format, engine_version, engine_contract, build_id, capabilities. build_id is FULL 40 uppercase hex chars: 03FF4A3BEC96BDE3A2E37CE3AA4CAA0CAE8935A8 (game build, not module hash). capabilities is a unique array of supported tokens; V0 package loader must explicitly advertise package.runtime/1, registry.slots/1, adapter.multi, timeline.gtf and/or timeline.gtl. Installer requires applicable capability for package, contract 1, engine_version >= 0.6.0 AND >= engine_min; version alone is not proof of loader. Strict JSON, no duplicate keys, 4 KiB bounded read. GE-151 release/install process owns marker and publishes it only after matching loader module and patches installed; remove/invalidate marker on rollback, failed update or incompatible engine. Native runtime independently checks build and its own compiled capabilities; marker is not a signature, nor proof of hardware behavior. CLI target overrides for validate/plan/synthetic fixture roots only; no override of missing/mismatched marker for real SD mutation or assignment. No marker shipped for v0.5.x or research builds lacking loader. Do not write a marker just to bypass the gate.

## C. Timeline and identity
Runtime profile only, Multi, two exact members. Require explicit effective start and results exit for GTF AND GTLM1; missing or duplicate/conflicting directives rejected, explicit match or any results native rejected, no silent default. Native parser parity, reject unsupported cue/raw arguments. Manifest title governs menu; mismatch with timeline title warning (preview shows both). New IDs generated once with cryptographic UUIDv4; imported valid legacy reverse-DNS IDs accepted with non-v4 warning, not silently regenerated. Identity comparisons case-sensitive canonical lowercase. Compare exact extracted member bytes for same ID/version; equal content is idempotent even with different ZIP wrapper. No downgrade or purge in V0 (including flags), pending save migration/rollback policy. A backup may be kept but cannot be used to overwrite a newer save silently.

## D. ZIP
Accept stricter GE-155 runtime envelope for implementation: stored/deflate only, no archive/member comments, no gaps/prefix/trailing bytes, no ZIP64, encryption, directories or unknown flags; extras restricted to 0x5455/0x7875/0x000A/0x5855 with valid bounded structure (canonical exporter omits extras), needed version <=20, descriptors only if exact central/local consistency. Exact ASCII member names, CRC/actual size, bounded streaming, strict JSON; draft 0.2 other caps unchanged. Explicit denylist is secondary, exact two-member allowlist authoritative. GE-153 must run shared corpus and export positive fixtures accepted byte-for-byte by host validator; coordinate error categories, not only success. Editor profile separate, no claim of runtime assets. Preserve f28f266 parser/security corrections when importing newer Gemini sources.

## E. Offline transaction and save ownership
Installer owns levels/, slots.json, .installer/, backups/; runtime ignores latter two except lock/journal fail-closed gate. Runtime alone owns custom-saves/. No deletion or overwrite by installer, including explicit purge in V0. Reserve backups for user-reviewed recovery; no automated deletion of unrelated paths. .gsv 160 B remains proposal, not frozen. GE-155 must validate recovery journal as untrusted input before any mutation (strict schema/state/op/id/tx/booleans/derived paths, no arbitrary path lists; reject tampered/missing artifacts and retain evidence). Never recover concurrently with active installer: shared exclusive OS lock or explicit verified offline recovery, no unconditional unlink of live lock. Acquire before read/check/assign and hold through recovery. Reject symlinks/junctions/reparse points in every traversed component, including root, installed members, journal/staging/backups; bound all installed-file reads. Test malicious journal, concurrent recover/install, invalid IDs, corrupt slots, unknown staging dirs, generation overflow and recovery interruption. Never delete unrelated tx-* directories blindly. Linux injected faults are not proof of actual FAT/exFAT power loss durability; Windows and Android tests required, document fsync/rename limitations. No SAF support claim until adapter exists.

## F. Pins and responsibilities
GE-155 Grok, branch grok/groove-package-validator, PR #8: revise validator/installer and shared synthetic corpus. Keep pinned exact GE-151 parser/contract with hashes until integrated, then use one authoritative tools implementation and differential test pinned snapshot; no independent drift. GE-151 Codex: implement marker producer, strict registry/loader, H0–H10 rev2, lifecycle ownership, H9/IO, build guard and native validation; no marker without functional loader. GE-153 Gemini: align exporter to revised envelope, preserve Codex fixes and test corpus. GE-154 coordinates; GE-156 hardware only after approval. No merge or install yet. This decision document is not a tested implementation.
